description_en: Generates structured reports from chest CT screening results. This capability works in depth collaboration with screening systems to convert screening quantization data into structured graphic reports, providing medical institutions with a full-flow Solutions from image analysis to report output
description_zh: 胸部CT平扫筛查结果报告生成能力与筛查系统深度协同，可将筛查量化数据转化为结构化图文报告，为医疗机构提供「影像分析-报告输出」全流程解决方案
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess generate-report --report-configs Action=CalcBMD Format=pdf TemplateVersion=1 Theme=dark --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateReport

fields.help_en:
The disease screening type. Valid values:

CalcBMD: osteoporosis screening.
MuscleFat: muscle and fat analysis.
DetectLiverSteatosis: fatty liver screening.
PredictCVD: cardiovascular adverse event risk assessment
fields.help_zh:
病种名称。
取值：
CalcBMD - 骨质疏松筛查,
MuscleFat -肌肉脂肪分析,
DetectLiverSteatosis-脂肪肝筛查,
PredictCVD-心血管不良事件风险评估
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: Optional. The report format. Default value: pdf. Currently, only the PDF format is supported
fields.help_zh: 可选，默认值pdf，当前仅支持pdf格式
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The graphic report template version. Valid values: 1
fields.help_zh: 图文报告模板版本号。取值：1
fields.name: template_version

fields.help_en:
The graphic report theme. Valid values:

dark: dark theme.
light: light theme
fields.help_zh: 图文报告主题。取值：dark - 深色主题 light - 浅色主题
fields.name: theme
